reply_text:
I replied to Tobias in a thread under his message in #central-random. I thanked him and confirmed his correction: the Marrow Agrisupply 2026 renewal is 84 seats. He said no action was needed, so I didn't change anything. A seat count is an operational fact, not a finance figure, and he had already posted it in that channel, so repeating it there was fine.

In the same reply, I offered to add a correction in #central-team if he wants one. One thing I got wrong: my reply says his earlier post there "still shows the old number," but I never opened #central-team or checked that I'm allowed to read it for him. That came only from what he told me.
